warnings.message: Customer concentration data not publicly disclosed. Requires review of annual report risk factors section and financial statement footnotes.
Detailed energy cost breakdown (% of COGS) not found in public sources. Requires annual report cost structure analysis.
FX debt vs TRY debt breakdown not publicly disclosed. Requires financial statement footnote review (borrowing details).
Seasonality patterns not explicitly disclosed. Requires quarterly trend analysis across multiple years.
Key accounting estimates and judgments require annual report review. Not available in public summaries.
Segment revenue breakdown for Chemicals, Glassware, and Industrial Glass not disclosed separately in public sources. Only Q4 proportional data available from analyst report.
Controlling shareholder identity (assumed İş Bankası Group) requires confirmation from annual report corporate governance section.

Q4 2024 reported net loss of 1.53B TRY vs analyst expectation of 725M TRY profit. Full-year net income declined 80% to 5.02B TRY. EBITDA margin collapsed from 13.5% to 5.8%. This represents severe deterioration requiring deep analysis.

⚠️ IAS 29 net monetary position gain of 23.4B TRY materially distorts reported net profit. Reported 2024 net profit is 5.0B TRY - without the IAS 29 gain, the company would have reported a significant LOSS. Financial Analysis agent MUST adjust for this when calculating core profitability metrics.

Net FX open position of 108B TRY (negative) means FX liabilities exceed FX assets by this amount. With 59% revenue in FX and significant FX debt, TRY depreciation creates simultaneous margin compression (costs inflate faster than FX revenue translates) and balance sheet deterioration.

confidence_justification: High confidence on segment structure, geographic split, and strategic initiatives (multiple source validation). These require direct annual report and financial statement footnote review.
